verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway runs headlessly by design. It can run as a Docker container in DB-less mode with declarative config, and it is configured through a RESTful Admin API. Kong also ships automation tooling built for scripted pipelines: decK for APIOps lifecycle automation, kongctl, official Terraform providers, and Go Admin API bindings. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline integration docs or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions/GitLab usage of decK), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
